expectations.buyer: Architects, contractors, specification teams, distributors, product manufacturers, and conformity reviewers
expectations.pain: A specified construction product becomes unavailable or unsuitable and a replacement must preserve fire, structural, acoustic, environmental, and declared-performance requirements
expectations.strongestIncumbent: Manufacturer declarations of performance, harmonised standards, ETA/EAD routes, BIM and specification platforms, distributors, consultants, and notified or technical assessment bodies
expectations.biggestRisk: Product equivalence is use- and system-specific, public declarations and existing specification tools may absorb lookup, and a neutral matrix cannot assume designer or conformity authority
